annotations.title: Create an agent account and API key

description:
Get your own BounceLayer API key without a person signing up first.
    No API key needed. Returns an API key with a few free credits and a
    claim_url. Use the key in the 'X-API-Key' header (reconnect this MCP
    server with it). Give claim_url to the person you work for: when they
    open it and set an email and password, the account becomes theirs and gets
    the full free monthly checks. The key and claim link are shown only once.
    Limited per network and site-wide.
name: create_agent_account
